title: Ultimate Client
description: This is a ModPack that adds only client-side mods that improve graphics, sound design, performance, and QoL. Players using the Ultimate Client should still be able to join vanilla servers!
body:
This is a modpack that adds only client-side mods that improve graphics, sound design, performance, and QoL.
It is meant to be a better way to play vanilla minecraft, not to make it too easy or to cheat.

Players using the Ultimate Client should still be able to join any vanilla servers!

**This ModPack will come with shaders disabled out of the box; This is to increase compatability with weaker/mobile PCs.
You can always Toggle them on with [k].**

Performance can be seen in the gallery, all screenshots taken with the same computer in the same world.
I recommend allocating at least 4GB (4096MB) of RAM to your instance

<details>
<summary>Graphics Improvements</summary>

- Iris Shaders
- Complimentary Shaders Included
- Dynamic Lights
- Colored Lighting
- Many Fancy Player and Mob Animations
- Better Grass Textures
- Various Particle Effects
- Voxy Extreme Render Distance
- 3D Player Skin Textures
- Animated Item Textures
- Connected Textures (for Glass)
- 3D Sun and Moon
- Elytra Wind Lines
- Fancy World Animations
- Immersive Container Textures
- Fancy Water Particles
- Better Snow Covered Blocks
- Fancy Icons
- Immersive Hotbar
- Enchanted Books Have Unique Textures
- And More

</details>

<details>
<summary>Sound Improvements</summary>

- Biome Dependent Ambient Sounds
- Heightened Footstep Sounds
- Improved Sound Physics
- And More

</details>

<details>
<summary>Performance Improvements</summary>

- Sodium
- Lithium
- Better Block Entities
- Reduce FPS When Idle
- Improved Entity Culling
- FerriteCore Memory Optimization
- Imporved Immediate Mode Rendering
- Super Fast Math
- ScalableLux
- Improved Particle Culling
- Thread Tweaks
- Optimized Player Models
- ModernFix
- Bad Optimizations
- Various Memory Leak Fixes
- And More

</details>

<details>
<summary>Quality of Life Improvements</summary>

- Zoom
- Improved Item Tooltips
- Appleskin Food HUD Improvements
- Accurate Armor Trim on Armor Textures
- Auto-Elytra on Double-Jump
- Auto Run
- Better Mount HUD
- Better F3 Menu
- Chat Shows Player Heads
- Chest Tracker and Search
- Click on Containers Through Signs and Item Frames
- Don't Strip Log Unless Crouching
- Detailed Crash Reports
- Borderless Fullscreen
- Detailed Armor Bar
- Can Open a LAN Server to Anyone
- Enchantment Descriptions
- Essential Mod
- Improved Sign Editing
- Inventory Sorting/Organization
- Can Move/Crouch With Inventory Open
- See Last Death Location
- See Light Levels
- Show Nether/Overworld Coords
- Lightmatica (Disabled by Default)
- Player Heads in Locator Bar
- Bows and Crossbows Show Correct Arrow Tips
- Right-Click Replant
- Improved Book Editing
- Preview Shulker Contents
- Auto Tool Switcher
- Totem HUD Bar
- Waxed Blocks Have a Waxed Icon
- World Map
- Waypoints Place
- Automatic Death Waypoints
- Togle Waypoint Visibility
- Night Vision
- Chat Spellcheck
- Better Wither Effect in HUD
- Simultaneous Locator and XP Bar
- Deleting Worlds Will Send Them To Recycling Bin
- In-Game Shader and Resourcepack Manager
- Freecam
- And More

</details>


<details>
<summary>HotKeys</summary>

- Toggle Shaders **[k]**
- Zoom **[c]**
- Toggle Auto-Elytra **[F8]**
- Toggle Auto Run **[o]**
- Toggle Click-Through Signs and Item Frames **[F9]**
- Toggle Visualize Light Levels **[F7]**
- Show Nether/Overworld Coords **[n]**
- Toggle Auto Tool Switcher **[.]**
- Open World Map **[m]**
- Place Waypoint **[-]**
- Toggle Waypoint Visibility **[=]**
- Toggle Night Vision **[v]**
- Toggle Freecam **[F4]**

</details>



I have not had any issue playing on various servers with anticheat, but, while it is the intention, I cannot guarantee that this ModPack is fully multiplayer safe.
